{"sql": "WITH yearly_consumption AS (
  SELECT 
    c.segment,
    CAST(SUBSTRING(ym.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.segment, CAST(SUBSTRING(ym.date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
consumption_pivot AS (
  SELECT 
    yc.segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yc.year = 2012 THEN yc.total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yc.year = 2013 THEN yc.total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM yearly_consumption yc
  WHERE yc.year IN (2012, 2013)
  GROUP BY yc.segment
)
SELECT 
  cp.segment,
  ((cp.consumption_2013 - cp.consumption_2012) / NULLIF(cp.consumption_2013, 0)) * 100 AS percentage_increase
FROM consumption_pivot cp
ORDER BY cp.percentage_increase DESC"}

{"sql": "WITH consumption_2013 AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customerid,
    c.segment,
    SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.customerid = ym.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND SUBSTRING(ym.date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
  SELECT 
    c1.segment,
    MIN(c1.total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM consumption_2013 c1
  GROUP BY c1.segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
  SELECT 
    c2.segment,
    c2.total_consumption
  FROM consumption_2013 c2
  JOIN min_per_segment m
    ON c2.segment = m.segment 
    AND c2.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
segment_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    l.segment,
    SUM(l.total_consumption) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS avg_consumption
  FROM lowest_customers l
  GROUP BY l.segment
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT s1.avg_consumption FROM segment_averages s1 WHERE s1.segment = 'SME') - 
  (SELECT s2.avg_consumption FROM segment_averages s2 WHERE s2.segment = 'LAM') AS sme_minus_lam,
  (SELECT s3.avg_consumption FROM segment_averages s3 WHERE s3.segment = 'LAM') -

{"sql": "WITH last_race_per_year AS (
  SELECT
    races.year,
    MAX(races.raceid) AS last_raceid
  FROM races
  WHERE races.year < 1975
  GROUP BY races.year
),
champions AS (
  SELECT
    last_race_per_year.year,
    driverstandings.driverid
  FROM last_race_per_year
  JOIN driverstandings ON last_race_per_year.last_raceid = driverstandings.raceid
  WHERE driverstandings.position = 1
),
champion_results AS (
  SELECT
    champions.year,
    results.milliseconds
  FROM champions
  JOIN results ON champions.driverid = results.driverid
  JOIN races ON results.raceid = races.raceid
  WHERE races.year = champions.year
    AND results.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  champion_results.year,
  AVG(CAST(champion_results.milliseconds AS FLOAT) / 1000) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM champion_results
GROUP BY champion_results.year
ORDER BY champion_results.year"}

{"sql": "WITH locally_funded AS (

{"sql": "WITH target_loan AS (
  SELECT loan.account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE loan.date = '1993-07-05'
  ORDER BY loan.loan_id

balance_start AS (
  SELECT trans.balance AS balance_value
  FROM trans
  JOIN target_loan ON trans.account_id = target_loan.account_id
  WHERE trans.date = '1993-03-22'
  ORDER BY trans.trans_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
  SELECT trans.balance AS balance_value
  FROM trans
  JOIN target_loan ON trans.account_id = target_loan.account_id
  WHERE trans.date = '1998-12-27'
  ORDER BY trans.trans_id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  ((balance_end.balance_value - balance_start.balance_value) / 
   NULLIF(balance_start.balance_value, 0)) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start
CROSS JOIN balance_end"}

{"sql": "WITH finished_results AS (
  SELECT r.position, r.milliseconds
  FROM results r
  JOIN races rc ON r.raceid = rc.raceid
  WHERE rc.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' 
    AND rc.year = 2008 
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
),
champion_ms AS (
  SELECT milliseconds AS champion_ms 
  FROM finished_results 
  WHERE position = 1
),
last_ms AS (
  SELECT milliseconds AS last_ms 
  FROM finished_results 
  WHERE position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM finished_results)
)
SELECT 
  ((last_ms.last_ms - champion_ms.champion_ms) / NULLIF(last_ms.last_ms, 0)) * 100
FROM champion_ms
CROSS JOIN last_ms"}
